_notes: POSSIBLE BUG: the question on the final status-update's status.message is ingested as an ordinary text part. The previous part is also text, so the two merge with no separator: "I can deploy that.Which environment: ...". The persisted answer reads as one run-on sentence.
The question's delta is posted before the `input-required` status event, so a consumer only learns the text was a question after rendering it as answer text.
No error and no dedicated event. input-required ends the turn as a normal completion with taskState input-required, and the user's answer travels as the next message (see resume_remembered_context).
